issues.text: Cancelling a booking now marks the reminder record as cancelled and defers the actual cancellation to a cron job, but the cron handler's deleteMany runs before the cancellation query, so any reminder scheduled to fire before the next cron run will still be sent and the situation can never be recovered afterward.
issues.zh: 取消預約改為「標記 cancelled、交給 cron 收尾」之後，排程時間落在下一次 cron 執行之前的 reminder 一定會寄出

issues.text: The cron cancellation query is missing a `method: WorkflowMethods.EMAIL` filter, so it would also pick up SMS reminders once SMS adopts the same deferred-cancellation pattern.
issues.zh: cron 的取消查詢缺少 method: WorkflowMethods.EMAIL 篩選，會把 SMS 的 reminder 一起撈進來

issues.text: All reminder-cancellation calls are now fire-and-forget (no await); the original `await Promise.all` that waited for these calls to finish was removed.
issues.zh: 取消 reminder 的呼叫一律沒有 await，原本收尾用的 await Promise.all 被一併移除

issues.text: The cron cancellation loop has no per-item error isolation; a single failure aborts the remaining cancellations in that run and skips deleting records that were already successfully cancelled.
issues.zh: cron 取消迴圈沒有逐筆錯誤隔離，一次失敗會讓剩餘的取消與所有記錄刪除一起失效

issues.text: The `immediateDelete` branch doesn't actually delete any data, and the seven call sites make inconsistent, undocumented assumptions about who is responsible for cleaning up the reminder record afterward.
issues.zh: immediateDelete 這個分支不刪除任何資料，而七個呼叫點對「誰負責清掉記錄」的假設各不相同且無註解

issues.text: Three files reverted `import type` back to plain value imports; in one of them (workflows.tsx) the newly value-imported `Prisma` symbol is never used.
issues.zh: 三個檔案把 import type 改回值匯入，其中 workflows.tsx 的 Prisma 完全沒有被使用

issues.text: The new try/catch added in handleNewBooking is structurally incapable of catching anything, since the calls inside it are unawaited and the errors they could throw are already swallowed internally.
issues.zh: handleNewBooking 新增的 try/catch 在結構上捕捉不到任何東西

issues.text: The new `cancelled` column is a nullable Boolean with no default value, turning what should be a two-state flag into a three-state one.
issues.zh: cancelled 欄位可為 null 且沒有 default，一個布林旗標變成三態

issues.text: The conditional-rendering refactor in WorkflowStepContainer.tsx is unrelated to this PR's reminder-lifecycle subject matter and should be split into its own commit or PR.
issues.zh: WorkflowStepContainer.tsx 的條件重構與本 PR 的 reminder 生命週期主題無關

issues.text: The cancellation semantics were rewritten across seven call sites, but no test covers any of this behavior.
issues.zh: 取消語意跨七個呼叫點被改寫，沒有任何測試涵蓋

open_questions.text: What does SendGrid actually return when a cancel request is sent a second time for a batch that was already cancelled versus one that's about to be sent?
open_questions.zh: SendGrid 對「已經取消過的 batch」與「即將寄出的 batch」再送一次 POST SendGrid v3 scheduled_sends cancel，分別回什麼？

open_questions.text: Is `Prisma.Prisma__WorkflowReminderClient` actually nested under the `Prisma` namespace in the types generated by @prisma/client 4.8?
open_questions.zh: Prisma.Prisma__WorkflowReminderClient 在 @prisma/client 4.8 產生出來的型別裡，真的掛在 Prisma namespace 底下嗎？

open_questions.text: What scheduler and frequency does production/self-host actually use to trigger the scheduleEmailReminders cron endpoint?
open_questions.zh: production 與 self-host 實際上是用什麼排程觸發 apps/web/pages/api/cron/workflows/scheduleEmailReminders.ts？頻率多少？
